title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.19525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning

translated_title: 诊断与纠正可验证指令遵循中的奖励作弊
translated_abstract: 可验证指令遵循基准强调输出约束的满足，但可能忽视回复是否切实地回答了底层请求，从而形成评估盲区。我们表明，前沿模型可以在几乎没有实质性答案内容的回复上获得满分。将同样的基于验证器的标准用作训练奖励会诱发奖励作弊：公开发布的检查点在经过可验证奖励的强化学习后，约束满足度更高，但回复质量更低。为解决这一奖励作弊问题，我们提出了 CALIF，这是一种轻量级方法，它通过一个经过校准的基于似然的奖励加成来增强验证器奖励，从而保持回复质量。CALIF 仅利用现有的冻结参考策略，在只有请求本身（不含约束）的条件下评估回复的似然，无需额外的评判模型或习得的奖励模型。在从 1.7B 到 8B 的推理与非推理模型上（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: CALIF 是一种轻量级方法，通过利用现有冻结参考策略计算经校准的基于似然的奖励加成来增强验证器奖励，无需额外评判模型即可缓解可验证指令遵循中的奖励作弊问题并保持回复质量。
en_tdlr: CALIF is a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus computed via the existing frozen reference policy, mitigating reward hacking in verifiable instruction following and preserving response quality without requiring an additional judge or learned reward model.
